# GitHub Copilot adapter

Follow the nearest applicable `AGENTS.md`. The root and scoped `AGENTS.md` files are the authoritative repository
engineering policy; do not duplicate build commands or compatibility claims here.

Treat the current GitHub issue or pull request as the task specification. For delegated work, routing, supervision, and
verification ownership, follow [`docs/ai-delivery/`](../docs/ai-delivery/README.md).

Do not merge, enable auto-merge, rewrite shared history, weaken tests, suppress failures, broaden task scope, or create
bespoke infrastructure without the explicit authority required by `AGENTS.md` and the current issue.
